title: Classic Solitaire
description: Relax with a traditional game of Klondike Solitaire.
about:
Classic Solitaire is a browser game where you move cards between tableau columns and foundation piles, building down by alternating color and up by suit.

Start a round in your browser and use the controls below to play.
howToPlay: Move cards between tableau columns and foundation piles, building down by alternating color and up by suit.
tips: Use click / drag to move a card or stack.
Try another round to practice the timing and strategy.

faq.question: How do I play Classic Solitaire?
faq.answer: Move cards between tableau columns and foundation piles, building down by alternating color and up by suit.

faq.question: Can I play Classic Solitaire in a browser?
faq.answer: Yes. Open the game page and play without installing an app.
